contracts.boundary: Restore main ancestry through the previously resolved merge without changing the existing product tree.
contracts.assertions: A real Git fixture demonstrates that squashing a conflict resolution leaves main unmerged and conflicting, while merging the original resolution preserves the current tree and makes the next main merge clean.

boundaryTest.name: preserves resolved main ancestry when a squash merge lost it

invariant.name: preserves resolved main ancestry when a squash merge lost it

fault.exception: In a disposable copy, removing the ancestry-restoring merge makes the named ancestry assertion fail.
